animations.name: strong kick
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Use the supplied first and last poses exactly, preserving identity, black outfit, sneakers, pixel art, scale and ground baseline. One powerful high strong kick from standing guard to full extension. Settle weight onto the planted supporting foot, chamber the knee high and lean the torso backward for explosive counterbalance, extending the rear arm straight back with open hand while keeping the front fist tucked tightly at the chest/jaw, and drive a crisp powerful high front-diagonal kick upward-right into the exact final pose with the sole angled forward. Preparation occupies roughly the first third; the kick accelerates smoothly and reaches maximum extension cleanly at the final frame. Keep the supporting foot anchored on the ground baseline; end exactly on the supplied impact pose. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no extra props, no motion trails or effects.
